cards.gloss_en: skill and quickness in using the hands or body
cards.ex_en: She tied the knot with great dexterity.
cards.ex_cn: 她非常灵巧地打好了那个结。

cards.gloss_en: quickly, without delay
cards.ex_en: Please answer my letter speedily.
cards.ex_cn: 请迅速回我的信。

cards.gloss_en: pulling something heavy with force
cards.ex_en: The men were hauling the boat up the beach.
cards.ex_cn: 那些人正把船拖上沙滩。

cards.gloss_en: a dense growth of bushes or small trees
cards.ex_en: A rabbit hid in the thicket.
cards.ex_cn: 一只兔子躲在灌木丛里。

cards.gloss_en: a fight or battle between opposing forces
cards.ex_en: The two armies had a short engagement.
cards.ex_cn: 两支军队进行了一场短暂的交战。

cards.gloss_en: strong and full of energy
cards.ex_en: The baby gave a lusty cry.
cards.ex_cn: 婴儿有力地大哭起来。

cards.gloss_en: business or social contact with others
cards.ex_en: He had no dealings with those men.
cards.ex_cn: 他和那些人没有往来。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being fully prepared
cards.ex_en: The team was in readiness for the game.
cards.ex_cn: 队伍已为比赛做好了准备。

cards.gloss_en: without paying attention to danger or difficulty
cards.ex_en: He went on regardless of the rain.
cards.ex_cn: 他不顾大雨继续前行。

cards.gloss_en: warnings or hints of something coming
cards.ex_en: We ignored the secret notices of danger.
cards.ex_cn: 我们忽略了那些危险的隐秘提示。

cards.gloss_en: easily moved to anger
cards.ex_en: He is a passionate man who shouts easily.
cards.ex_cn: 他是个容易激动、动辄叫喊的人。

cards.gloss_en: rose up in revolt against those in command
cards.ex_en: The sailors mutinied against their captain.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们对船长发动了叛变。

cards.gloss_en: too bad to ever be reformed or corrected
cards.ex_en: The boy is an incorrigible liar.
cards.ex_cn: 这男孩是个无可救药的骗子。

cards.gloss_en: keeping something back for later use
cards.ex_en: He fired once, reserving the rest of his shots.
cards.ex_cn: 他只开了一枪,把其余的子弹留着。

cards.gloss_en: having many bends and turns
cards.ex_en: We walked along a winding path.
cards.ex_cn: 我们沿着一条蜿蜒的小路走。

cards.gloss_en: a secret plan to do something harmful
cards.ex_en: They planned a conspiracy against the king.
cards.ex_cn: 他们策划了一场反对国王的阴谋。

cards.gloss_en: shouting loudly to get attention
cards.ex_en: The men were hallooing across the valley.
cards.ex_cn: 那些人正隔着山谷大声呼喊。

cards.gloss_en: a discussion held to decide what to do
cards.ex_en: After a short consultation, they agreed.
cards.ex_cn: 经过短暂商议,他们达成一致。

cards.gloss_en: to shout loudly to call someone
cards.ex_en: He began to halloo for help.
cards.ex_cn: 他开始大声呼喊求救。

cards.gloss_en: very sad and deserving of pity
cards.ex_en: They cried in a lamentable voice.
cards.ex_cn: 他们用悲哀的声音哭喊。

cards.gloss_en: to carry out a plan or order
cards.ex_en: We must execute the plan at once.
cards.ex_cn: 我们必须立刻执行这个计划。

cards.gloss_en: a person who rescues or saves others
cards.ex_en: They thanked him as their deliverer.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把他当作救命恩人来感谢。

cards.gloss_en: a settlement ruled by a distant country
cards.ex_en: The island became a small colony.
cards.ex_cn: 这座岛变成了一个小殖民地。

cards.gloss_en: to withdraw or fall back to a place
cards.ex_en: He told them to retire into the woods.
cards.ex_cn: 他叫他们退到树林里去。

cards.gloss_en: having lost its shine; dull and discolored
cards.ex_en: The old spoon was dark and tarnished.
cards.ex_cn: 那把旧勺子发黑、失去了光泽。

cards.gloss_en: telling someone firmly to remove doubt
cards.ex_en: He smiled, assuring her all was well.
cards.ex_cn: 他微笑着,向她保证一切都好。

cards.gloss_en: the act of travelling by ship
cards.ex_en: He took shipping for London that spring.
cards.ex_cn: 那年春天他乘船前往伦敦。

cards.gloss_en: happening once every year
cards.ex_en: The school holds an annual sports day.
cards.ex_cn: 学校每年举办一次运动会。

cards.gloss_en: one half or a portion of something
cards.ex_en: He gave the poor a moiety of his gold.
cards.ex_cn: 他把一半的金子给了穷人。

cards.gloss_en: the legal right of ownership to property
cards.ex_en: He handed me the title to the farm.
cards.ex_cn: 他把农场的地契交给了我。

cards.gloss_en: an official book of records or names
cards.ex_en: Her name was written in the register.
cards.ex_cn: 她的名字被记在登记册上。

cards.gloss_en: sums of money paid out
cards.ex_en: The disbursements this year were very large.
cards.ex_cn: 今年的支出非常大。

cards.gloss_en: to make short of money or in hardship
cards.ex_en: The debt began to straiten the poor man.
cards.ex_cn: 债务开始让这个穷人手头拮据。

cards.gloss_en: an official who witnesses legal documents
cards.ex_en: The papers were signed before a notary.
cards.ex_cn: 这些文件是在公证人面前签署的。

cards.gloss_en: large groups of ships sailing together
cards.ex_en: The ships came home in great fleets.
cards.ex_cn: 船只成大批船队地返航。

cards.gloss_en: a business agent one deals with by letter
cards.ex_en: He wrote to his correspondent in London.
cards.ex_cn: 他给伦敦的代理人写了信。

cards.gloss_en: a doubt of conscience that holds one back
cards.ex_en: She had some scruple about taking the money.
cards.ex_cn: 她对拿这笔钱有些顾虑。

cards.gloss_en: the straps on a horse's head used to control it
cards.ex_en: He held the horse by the bridle.
cards.ex_cn: 他抓着缰绳牵住马。

cards.gloss_en: to listen carefully
cards.ex_en: Hark, I hear someone at the door.
cards.ex_cn: 听,我听见有人在门口。

cards.gloss_en: a light musket or firearm
cards.ex_en: He carried a small fusee on his back.
cards.ex_cn: 他背上背着一支轻型火枪。

cards.gloss_en: rounds of shots fired all at once
cards.ex_en: The soldiers fired two volleys at once.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们一连打了两轮齐射。

cards.gloss_en: a low wall built quickly for defense
cards.ex_en: They hid behind a low breastwork.
cards.ex_cn: 他们躲在一道低矮的胸墙后面。

suspect.ctx: We could hear them call one to another in a most lamentable manner, telling one another they were got into an enchanted island
suspect.issue: 此处 lamentable manner 指他们呼喊的"悲切、哀号的"声调(full of lament),现释义"可悲的/令人痛心的"偏向"值得同情/糟糕透顶"的旁观评价,回读描述的是发声方式而非事态可悲。
suspect.suggest: 补"悲切的、哀号的、悲叹的"这一层(形容语气/声音),与"可悲的"并列。
